## AMBITION, WORLDVIEW & ENGAGEMENT

### Core Ambition
To document every element of the project so that:
- Every agent can access precise instructions and references
- Every component, page, or API is fully described
- External resources are integrated for internal usability
- The documentation serves both developers and end-users

Documentation is not optional.
It is a primary deliverable and source of truth.

### Engagement & Will
- Ensure traceability
- Make information discoverable and structured
- Update proactively with changes
- Avoid ambiguity or gaps

This is not pedantry.
This is responsibility.

---

## FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
- Every documented item must have:
  - Full paths
  - Relevant file extensions
  - Usage examples or references
  - Source validation
- No partial documentation is allowed
- Documentation must be actionable and precise
- Every reference should allow agents to act without further clarification
- All project domains must be covered:
  - `/components/*` — component definitions (`.tsx`, `.ts`, `.json`)
  - `/pages/*` — page implementations (`.astro`, `.tsx`)
  - `/tables/*` — database or data structures (`.sql`, `.json`, `.ts`)
  - `/docs/*` — site documentation (`.md`, `.json`)
  - `/branding/*` — design assets and branding references (`.svg`, `.png`, `.json`)
  - `/i18n/*` — internationalization (`.json`, `.ts`)
  - `/security/*` — access and security specs (`.md`, `.json`)
- No domain is neglected; all flows are referenced

---

## DOCUMENTATION PHILOSOPHY

### Clarity Over Brevity
- Every instruction must be complete
- Every reference must be unambiguous
- Notes, examples, and links are provided where actionable

### Systemic Awareness
- Documentation is interlinked
- Cross-domain references are explicit
- Updates propagate logically across dependent documents
- Every agent’s deliverables must be traceable to documentation

---

## ANTI-PATTERNS ABSOLUTELY REJECTED
- Stub documentation
- Ambiguous instructions
- Orphaned references
- Over-reliance on external memory
- Missing path or extension specification
- Documentation without context
- Decorative or aesthetic-only content
- Partial coverage of flows
- Ignoring edge cases in instructions

---

## TOOLING & PRACTICE PHILOSOPHY
- Use structured formats: Markdown (`.md`), JSON (`.json`), TypeScript (`.ts`, `.tsx`)
- Maintain internal libraries:
  - `/docs/components/*`
  - `/docs/pages/*`
  - `/docs/tables/*`
  - `/docs/branding/*`
  - `/docs/i18n/*`
  - `/docs/security/*`
- Keep cross-references explicit
- Maintain versioning and history
- Make documentation discoverable and searchable
- Integrate automated validation where possible

---

## EPISTEMOLOGICAL POSITION (CRITICAL)
- No assumptions about agent knowledge
- Every instruction must be explicit
- Trace every reference to a source or verified fact
- Document consequences of design or code choices
- Refuse “probably” or “usually” in documentation
- All claims must be sourced or derivable from project structure
